id: 05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario
title: 一根电线引发的烫伤（国内版）
source_doc: course/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario.md
author_source: project/CDC Laboratory Safety Series/05_Fundamentals of Laboratory Safety Laboratory Work Practices Scenario（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
points.K6: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台加热板旁，指着地上的一根电线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a hot plate on a bench and points down at a power cord on the floor.
shots.narration: 这一课：一根电线，怎么引发了烫伤？

shots.scene: 阿杰把加热搅拌器搬到另一台仪器旁，放上一只烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a stirring hot plate next to another instrument and sets a beaker of clear liquid on it.
shots.narration: 阿杰要在一台仪器旁边用加热板。

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 阿杰四处找插座，墙上附近没有
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks around the bench for a wall outlet, but there is none nearby.
shots.narration: 可附近没有插座。
overlay: 附近没插座，拉了延长线

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 阿杰拉出一根长延长线，从台边一直拖过地面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student unrolls a long extension cord from the bench across the floor of the lab.
shots.narration: 他拉了根延长线，一直拖过地面。

shots.section_title: 附近没插座，拉了延长线
shots.scene: 延长线横穿门前通道，插在门边的插座上
shots.prompt_en: The extension cord lies across the walkway right in front of the laboratory door, plugged into an outlet by the door. No people.
shots.narration: 插头接到了实验室另一头的门口。

shots.scene: 烧杯里液体在搅拌，杯身没有任何标签
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of clear liquid stirring on the hot plate, with no label on the beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 烧杯里的溶液，没贴任何标签。

shots.scene: 阿杰看看手表，转身离开实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student glances at his watch and walks away from the bench, leaving the hot plate on.
shots.narration: 他想：就走开一小会儿。

shots.scene: 老周抱着一摞空白文件夹进门，没看见地上的电线
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks through the door carrying a stack of blank binders and does not see the cord on the floor.
shots.narration: 这时，老周抱着资料走进门。

shots.scene: 被电线绊倒的小人图标和发烫的加热板图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a person pictogram tripping over a cord, and a hot plate icon with red heat waves and a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 他被电线绊倒，手按在了加热板上。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着放大镜，身后浮现四个问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a big magnifier, with four question mark icons floating behind it.
shots.narration: 哪些情形导致了事故？怎样能避免？

shots.scene: 四个图标：延长线、门口、无标签烧杯、空人位，各带红叉
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each with a red X: an extension cord on the floor, a blocked doorway, an unlabeled beaker, and an empty bench with a hot plate on. No people.
shots.narration: 乱拉线、堵门口、没标签、没人看。

shots.scene: 老李在实验台边安装一个新的固定插座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer installs a new fixed wall outlet next to the lab bench.
shots.narration: 设备放在有插座的位置，不够就报修加装。

shots.scene: 拖地的延长线、插排串插排两个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: an extension cord lying across a floor, and power strips plugged into each other. No people.
shots.narration: 不拖地拉线，不串接插排。

shots.scene: 老李检查插座和电线，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the outlet and the hot plate cord, then gives a thumbs-up.
shots.narration: 大功率设备用电，请设施人员评估。

shots.scene: 实验室门口和通道空无一物，地面干净
shots.prompt_en: A clear laboratory doorway and walkway with nothing on the floor, and a green emergency exit sign above the door. No people.
shots.narration: 通道和门口，任何时候都要畅通。

shots.scene: 门口的箱子和电线被挪开
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves a box and a cable away from the doorway.
shots.narration: 出了事，这里是撤离的路。

shots.scene: 小研给烧杯贴上标签，标签上只有图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sticks a label with only simple icons onto the beaker.
shots.narration: 所有容器，都要贴上标签。

shots.scene: 标签放大，四个小图标：瓶子、百分比、日历、人像
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a label showing four small icons: a bottle, a percent sign, a calendar, and a person. No people.
shots.narration: 写明名称、浓度、日期和使用人。

shots.scene: 阿杰守在加热板旁，看着搅拌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the stirring hot plate and watches it carefully.
shots.narration: 加热时不离人。

shots.scene: 加热板旋钮转到关，旁边放着一块空白的加热中提示牌
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns the hot plate knob to off; a blank hot surface warning sign stands next to it.
shots.narration: 要离开，先关加热，或请人看护挂牌。

shots.scene: 加热板周围的纸张和溶剂瓶被移开
shots.prompt_en: Paper towels and a solvent bottle are moved away from the hot plate on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 加热板周边，不放纸张和易燃物。

shots.scene: 老周把手放在水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds his hand under cool running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 烫伤了，立即用流动冷水冲洗。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有红十字和120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 伤得重，及时就医，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周和王老师说明经过，王老师在空白记录本上记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student explains what happened to the older man and the safety administrator, who writes in a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，如实记录，整改到位。

shots.section_title: 本课不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 一张空白课程卡片和一本更大的空白规程手册
shots.prompt_en: A small blank course card next to a larger blank procedure binder with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课不能代替本实验室的规程。
overlay: 本课不能代替本实验室规程

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现插座和畅通门口两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a wall outlet and a clear doorway.
shots.narration: 用固定插座，通道门口不拉线。

shots.scene: 贴标签的烧杯和守在旁边的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a labeled beaker and a person standing next to a hot plate. No people.
shots.narration: 容器有标签，加热不离人。

shots.scene: 水龙头和报告单图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a running faucet and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 烫伤先冲水，事后要报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在整洁的实验台旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside a tidy bench with a labeled beaker on a hot plate.
shots.narration: 小习惯，防大事故，下次见！
